rejection_reason: Example rejection: do not promote v0.2 into canon until schema, validator, and ADR gate pass.
what_would_be_lost_if_wrongly_rejected: The system could lose durable memory of uncomfortable horizon shifts and keep optimizing for operator approval.
proposal_risk: The proposal may over-formalize disagreement and create procedural weight before enough evidence exists.
operator_bias_risk: The agent may frame the rejection to please the operator, either by making the proposal too agreeable or by dramatizing refusal instead of preserving testable disagreement.
reopen_on_new_evidence: Reopen if rejected dry-run proposals disappear without review, or if repeated proposals become approval-shaped despite evidence gaps.
evidence_to_watch: Horizon dry-run logs with rejected but unresolved map shifts
next_review_trigger: After first real rejected Horizon proposal or before GitHub/Builder mirror.
